The derivation checks out. Placing $X$ at the origin with the chords on the axes, the power of the point gives $R^2 = \tfrac12 + s$, where $s = -ab = -cd = -ef > 0$. Substituting $s = 10/7$ or $s = 2$ into the constraint $OX^2 = \tfrac12$ satisfies it in both cases (for $s = 2$: $O = (-\tfrac12, 0, \tfrac12)$; for $s = \tfrac{10}{7}$: $O = (-\tfrac{3}{14}, \tfrac{\sqrt2}{7}, \tfrac{9}{14})$). The two values are $R^2 = \tfrac{27}{14}$ and $R^2 = \tfrac52$, and their sum is $\tfrac{27}{14} + \tfrac{35}{14} = \tfrac{31}{7}$.
